plan.title: SRC-AWD-001 — Award all units to Vendor A

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before testing the prepared RFQ.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate is 100.
Verify Vendor A's offered quantity matches the prepared 10-unit line.
Verify Vendor A's line amount and total use rate multiplied by quantity.
Allocate the full line to Vendor A, create and submit the award proposal, and complete the award without invoking a separate approval step.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the post-award flow and read back the generated purchase order data.
Assert that the resulting purchase order carries the single awarded line with quantity 10.
